# Generic "must never be committed" patterns (extended regex, one per line; '#' = comment).
# Deliberately broad and platform-agnostic: covers mainstream cloud, VCS, AI, SaaS,
# payment, messaging, registry, and key formats without identifying any specific provider in use.

# Private keys & certificates with embedded private material
-----BEGIN (RSA |EC |DSA |OPENSSH |PGP |ENCRYPTED )?PRIVATE KEY-----

# Cloud providers (AWS, GCP/Google, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Azure, DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, etc.)
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(AKIA|ASIA|AIDA|AROA)[0-9A-Z]{16}($|[^[:alnum:]_])
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])LTAI[0-9A-Za-z]{12,24}($|[^[:alnum:]_])
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])AKID[0-9A-Za-z]{20,40}($|[^[:alnum:]_])
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(CLOUDFLARE|CF|AWS|AZURE|GCP|ALIYUN|ALIBABA|TENCENT|HUAWEI|VOLC|DO|DIGITALOCEAN|VERCEL|NETLIFY|FLY|RAILWAY)_(API_TOKEN|ACCESS_KEY|SECRET_KEY|SECRET_ACCESS_KEY|ACCOUNT_ID|ZONE_ID|CLIENT_SECRET)[ ]*[:=][ ]*["']?[A-Za-z0-9_./+=-]{20,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])dop_v1_[0-9a-f]{64}($|[^[:alnum:]_])
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])DefaultEndpointsProtocol=https;AccountName=[^;[:space:]]+;AccountKey=[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{20,}

# Version control & CI platforms (GitHub, GitLab)
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])glpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}

# AI / LLM & ML platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Hugging Face, Groq, xAI, Replicate, Perplexity)
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])sk-(proj-|ant-api[0-9]+-|or-v1-)?[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])gsk_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])xai-[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])r8_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])pplx-[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}

# Messaging, SaaS, payments & package registries (Slack, Stripe, SendGrid, npm, PyPI, crates.io)
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])(sk|rk)_(live|test)_[0-9A-Za-z]{20,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SG\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])npm_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])pypi-AgEI[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}
(^|[^[:alnum:]_])cio[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}

# Local home/secret directory paths
(/home/[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*/|/Users/[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/)(secrets|\.ssh|\.config|\.aws|\.kube|\.gnupg)
